ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all students in the College of Business and to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 13, 2017 at approxmiately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to business minor students on Monday, November 20, 2017 and to ISE students on Monday, November 27, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 19, 2018 around 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
